title: Burn the Bastards
blurb: Penelope has a better plan for the suitors, and it involves fire.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Twenty years holding the throne alone. Furious.

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.description: Her son, back from Sparta with a desperate plan.

lines.text: Lock the door, set a fire, and burn the bastards.
lines.direction: Deadly calm. Then spit the last words.

lines.text: Do you think if I remarry, life goes back to the way it was?
lines.direction: Softer now. Make him see it.

lines.text: That world is gone, and in this one, they're not giving up power to you or Odysseus.
lines.direction: Grip the table. Every word is a blade.

lines.text: If he returned, he'd have to kill them, like you will.
lines.direction: Point at him: this is his fate too.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
